The isolation kernel ensures that no prior session artifacts leak into the current build, enforcing a clean state transition. The build state transition primitive maps the 6 defined builds to a deterministic state evolution. Contamination is modeled as a binary condition (0 or 1), ensuring that all artifacts are fresh and uncorrupted by prior sessions. This structure supports both Bayesian inference (via belief updates) and situational reasoning (via state transitions). Failure modes include contamination (C > 0) or mismatched build counts (Σ(B) ≠ 6).
